lines: Venerable supreme Pravara-named city and there which was made by Pravarasena thus earth-lord; who at end of own established Maheśvara worship sky rising released indeed incense bell.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śrīmatparaṃ pravaranāma puraṃ ca tatra yannirmame pravarasena iti kṣitīśaḥ yaḥ svapratiṣṭhitamaheśvarapūjanānte vyomotpatannudasṛjatkila dhūpaghaṇṭām
